summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge by analyzing Soony's confidential launch data, then building and polishing a product (Lighthouse) that rechecks the launch plan, flags contradictions, and acts via supplier emails and phone calls before the Sunday 12:00 hand-in.
summary.outcome: Found that Soony's plan said all ok while the Collector's Edition missed launch (art books overbooked by 72,000, failed statues, sleeve rev conflict, cards short). Built a polling, versioned, agent-driven FastAPI/React app with role-split views (Felix/Maren), History, Fixed today, and merged PR #8. Latest commits are on main but unpushed, live not restarted, and the deck and video are still open.

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip) with no webhooks or notifications; the documented approach is polling the file list and comparing SHA-256, since files get replaced under the same name.
Portal data is confidential and must stay gitignored, but PR #8 merged 335 files under data/portal into main; removing them needs git rm -r --cached data/portal and leaves them in history.
Demo instance (:8001) runs without a portal token on purpose, so it never polls; the heartbeat now depends on a server flag that reuses the runner's token check.
Entire only writes a checkpoint when repo files change; entire status and entire brain status must pass before pushing, and Entire uploads checkpoints on push.

Team workflow lives in CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md; no attribution trailers, no em dashes, ask before every push, never approve or dismiss cards on live data in tests because approvals send real supplier emails.
Outbox sync previously overwrote concurrently written actions; the fix appends under api._lock.
Soony data quirks: German PO export is cp1252 with semicolons, handled by read_csv fallback; lid magnets are a false alarm because PackRight fits them into the box.
workflow: Use a separate git worktree (../ask-soony-llm-task-update) to pull and test a teammate's branch while live and demo servers run from main.
Run experiments and screenshots on read-only preview servers or state copies, never on live state.
Use a subagent for bulk cross-checks (200 order confirmations plus 59 scans) and keep results local.
Verify UI changes with headless-browser screenshots; this caught misaligned tabs and the wrong 'Decided by you' label for Maren.
Check what a screen already shows before adding a feature; the proposed 'Covered' green line would have duplicated existing content and was swapped for 'Fixed today'.

friction: Granting a role change was misread: the user wanted role added next to names, but names were replaced, which required a rework and a fix to Maren's 'Ask Maren to approve' label.
Heartbeat 'Not checked since 08:30' appeared on the demo, which intentionally never polls, looking broken.
PR #8 opened with a test-file merge conflict and contained 335 confidential data files; it was merged before they were removed.
Fixed today first read supplier reply fields and wrongly listed Boise's cards arriving after launch; it had to switch to confirmed-orders data.
Demo background loop does not auto-raise call alerts; the Realtime call was cut off by noise and concurrent responses before fixes.
Approver view initially showed 'unless N decisions go through' while seeing only her own subset of cases.
open_items: Push main (about 10+ commits ahead of origin) and restart the live server so the sign-in choice, 'Waiting for your OK' and heartbeat appear there.
Remove portal data (data/portal) from main with git rm -r --cached, and decide whether stored readings and golden.json stay in the repo.
Build the 6-slide pitch deck and record the video for the 12:00 hand-in, using Lio figures, the network map and Maren's 'We find out at the dock' quote.
Fix demo background loop not auto-raising call alerts.

Optional: delete the duplicate routine 'Ask Hamburg to count book stock' on live; send notes to Hwaseong and Lucas about the Pulse emails; add a top bar for Maren and a 'What still saves it' section on Launch.
After the demo, point the OpenAI webhook back to https://ask-soony.stenglein.dev/hooks/openai.
Commit the last 'Decided' label fix for Maren if not yet committed, and view the new pages in a real browser.
